Definition: to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tremble, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, break, be terrified, cause to tremble; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cause to tremble, terrify; 1b2) to tremble, feel dread; 1b) (Niphal) to be awesome, be terrible; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to regard or treat with awe, regard or treat as awful; 1c2) to inspire with awe, terrify
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
